concept.title: Concept topics
concept.abstract: This chapter introduces DITA concept topics as the primary structure for explaining ideas, systems, features, relationships, and foundational knowledge. It covers the purpose, characteristics, and core elements of concept topics, demonstrating how descriptive content, examples, diagrams, and visual representations can be used to build user understanding before procedural or reference-based information is presented. The chapter emphasizes creating explanatory, context-rich content that answers what a subject is, why it matters, and how it fits within a broader information model.

conbody.p: Concept topics explain what something is, why it matters, and how it works. They provide the foundational understanding required before performing tasks.
